title: What's on the gameday menu? PepsiCo snacks, sips and team spirit
summary: PepsiCo’s football season lineup brings together Tostitos chips and dips, Quaker and Pepsi for gatherings built around food and company.
body_markdown:
## How can drinks bring team spirit to the table?


As the Official Soft Drink of the NFL and partner of 15 teams, Pepsi continues to celebrate football culture with its “Tailgating Deserves Pepsi” platform, built around the message that gameday food tastes better with the bold taste of Pepsi.


The latest campaign comes to life through creative starring[Pro Football Hall of Famer Jerome “The Bus” Bettis and NFL superstar Justin Jefferson](https://www.pepsico.com/newsroom/press-releases/2026/pepsi-kicks-off-its-26th-nfl-season-with-jerome-bettis-justin-jefferson-fans-tailgating-pepsi) . Bettis plays the Pepsi gameday ref, throwing the flag when fan-favorite foods need an ice-cold Pepsi, while Jefferson delivers a highlight-worthy assist. It’s a playful reminder for Vikings and Steelers fans — and every host — that when burgers, wings, pizza or other tailgate favorites are on the menu, Pepsi belongs in the lineup.


## How can hosts keep a gameday menu simple?


For a game day spread, start with a variety of chips and dips, add a new flavor to share and set out some ice-cold Pepsi. Team-inspired packaging can make the table feel like part of the occasion. To expand the menu with a home cooked dish, try one of[FLVR’s game day recipes](https://www.flvrrecipes.com/inspiration/occasion/game-day) . Whether you’re gathering friends for a rivalry game or cheering on your favorite team, bringing people together to enjoy great food, drinks and football is what the season is all about.
